Swain|mid.identity: Magic damage battle mage. Death's Hand (Q) fires bolts in a cone, Vision of Empire (W) strikes a distant area after a delay, reveals and slows, Nevermove (E) throws a projectile that returns and roots, then can pull rooted champions toward him, and Demonic Ascension (R) transforms him: he drains nearby enemies and heals, then can unleash an explosion. His ravens collect soul fragments that heal him and permanently increase his health (passive).
Swain|mid.playstyle: In mid, Swain is a durable battle mage who wins extended fights thanks to his ultimate's drain. He punishes melee fighters and mages (Galio, Akali, Lissandra), but struggles against long-range or very mobile mages (Zoe, Hwei, Aurora).
Swain|mid.early_game: Poke with Q and W, root with E when your opponent walks into melee range. Recast E to pull the rooted target: E → pull → Q. Keep E to defend yourself against assassins.
Swain|mid.level_1: Nevermove (E) or Death's Hand (Q). E punishes an engage; Q is for farming and poking.
Swain|mid.level_2: Whichever of Q and E you're missing. E (CC) → recast to pull → Q.
Swain|mid.level_3: Vision of Empire (W). Long-range poke, vision and a slow: also useful to help other lanes.
Swain|mid.level_6: Demonic Ascension: a constant drain around you, then an explosion. You win long fights against melee champions.
power_spikes: First completed item: very durable in fights.
Swain|mid.lane_plan: Poke and farm, keep E for engages. Use W to help other lanes from range. Push, then join fights: Swain shines in long fights. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you come back fast.
Swain|mid.trading: Short trade: Q + W. All-in: E → pull → Q → R. Give up on it against mages who poke you from out of range (Zoe, Hwei).
threats: Zoe, Hwei and Aurora: hard matchups.
mistakes: Wasting E and no longer being able to defend yourself.
Casting your ultimate too far from enemies.

matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep E for the end of her ultimate.
matchup_notes.Sylas: Careful: he can steal your drain ultimate.
matchup_notes.Zed: Root him when he swaps back to his shadow.
matchup_notes.Zoe: She pokes you from very far away: stay behind your minions.
matchup_notes.Hwei: He pokes you: play around your jungler.

Swain|mid.mid_game: Join fights and win the long ones with your ultimate.
Swain|mid.late_game: Mage frontline: go in with R, drain and explode. E to root the diver.
Swain|mid.ahead: Force long fights and take objectives.
Swain|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to win extended fights thanks to your ultimate's drain.
Swain|mid.final_tip: Root with E, recast to pull the target, then Q: it's your best combo.
